newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee dips on commercial demand for dlrs.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee dips on commercial demand for dlrs.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee fell in late trading on import covering demand for dollars, after rising early when speculators sold the dollar, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 57.77 to the dollar after opening at 57.75. The rupee closed at 57.74 on Thursday.
"A state bank buying to cover imports pushed the dollar back up after it fell to 57.70 rupees," said an American Express Bank dealer.
Overnight call money rates closed at 11.5 percent after opening at 13, with the market well offered, dealers said.
